Dear Sir/Madam,
Subject: Outcome of the Board Meeting – October 28, 2026
Pursuant to the requirements of Regulation 30 and 33 read with Schedule III of the Securities and Exchange
Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (‘Listing Regulations’),
we wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held today i.e. on Wednesday,
October 28, 2026, have, inter alia, considered and approved the following items of business(es):
1. The Unaudited Standalone & Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended
September 30, 2026:
The Board has approved the unaudited Standalone & Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the
quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
A copy of the said results of the Company along with Limited Review Reports thereon, which have been taken
on record, are enclosed herewith as Annexure-I.
Press Release dated October 28, 2026 on the unaudited Standalone & Consolidated Financial Results of the
Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 is enclosed herewith as Annexure-II.
Further, Earnings Update/Investor Presentation is enclosed herewith as Annexure-III, and is also being made
available on the website of the Company at: www.infoedge.in/InvestorRelations/corporate_Presentations
2. Declaration of Interim Dividend for the FY 2026-27:
The Board has declared Interim Dividend of Rs. 3/- per share (on face value of Rs. 2/- per share) for the financial
year 2026-27.
Record date for the purpose of determining the name of the members eligible for receipt of the Interim Dividend
will be Friday, November 6, 2026.
The dividend would be paid on or after November 23, 2026.
The exchanges are also informed that the Board Meeting commenced at 10:30 a.m. and the results have been
considered and approved by the Board at 11:40 a.m. The same are hereby furnished to the Stock Exchanges,
while the meeting continues for considering remaining agenda items at the time of this intimation and
is expected to end around 01:30 p.m.

its Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter ended September 30th,
2026.
Info Edge (India) Limited reported revenue from operations of Rs. 841.7 crore on a standalone basis
for the quarter ended September 30th, 2026, a year-over-year growth of 12.8%. Operating PBT grew
by 29.8% YoY to Rs. 347.3 crore, and the operating PBT margin was 41.3% of revenue in Q2FY27. The
standalone business generated cash from operations (before taxes) of Rs. 372.8 crore during the
quarter, a 27.4% YoY improvement.
Standalone billings grew by 12.8% year-on-year for the quarter, reaching Rs. 822.3 crore. For the half
year, standalone billings grew by 13.5% to Rs. 1,559.3 crore.
In its largest business, Recruitment, billings grew by 12.6% in Q2 and 14.9% in H1, with quarterly
growth affected by the timing of customer renewals. Recruitment revenue grew by 13.3% YoY, and
operating PBT grew by 19.9% with an operating PBT margin of 59.1% in the second quarter of FY27.
99acres billings grew by 21.2% in Q2, up from 16.5% in Q1. The business generated cash from
operations of Rs. 22.1 crore in the quarter, compared with Rs. 2.3 crore in Q2FY26.
In Matchmaking, combined billings for Jeevansathi and Aisle grew by 23.1% in Q2 and 21.7% in H1,
with Jeevansathi growing by 18.4% and Aisle by 40.0% in the quarter.
While announcing the results, Mr. Hitesh Oberoi, Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer, said,
"Recruitment billings grew 15% in H1. AI and data products for recruiters and job seekers are now
contributing meaningfully, at a high single-digit share of Recruitment topline and an annualized run
rate of around Rs. 240 crore based on Q2. 99acres extended its market leadership, with billings growth
accelerating to 21%, and Matchmaking continued to grow well."
Mr. Himanshu Agarwal, Chief Financial Officer, said, "Standalone billings grew 13.5% in the first half,
and operating profits increased by 29.8% in the quarter. Cash generated from operations grew by
27.4% in the quarter, reflecting the continued strength of the Company's cash-generative model."
